name: satpy-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Satpy, a Python library for reading, manipulating and writing data from
meteorological remote-sensing satellite instruments. Its data are `xarray.DataArray` objects backed by dask arrays.
Compositors combine one or more data arrays into new products (RGB and single-band composites, day/night blending,
filling, masking and cloud compositors, sharpening, lookup-table and colormap composites), enhancements turn data
into images (stretches, gamma, inversion, colorization and palettes, convolution effects, and the YAML-configured
enhancement matching), modifiers adjust data before compositing (sun-zenith and path-length corrections and related
angle utilities), and the `satpy.dataset` package identifies and queries data arrays (`DataID`, `DataQuery`,
`DatasetDict`, metadata combination).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The documentation and the code under repair are: the satpy/composites, satpy/enhancements, satpy/modifiers and
satpy/dataset packages, the modules satpy/decision_tree.py, satpy/_config.py and satpy/plugin_base.py, the pages
README.rst, doc/source/composites.rst, doc/source/enhancements.rst, doc/source/modifiers.rst and
doc/source/dev_guide/satpy_internals.rst, and the docstrings of those modules (module, class, function and method
docstrings, including their examples).

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implement
